title: Possible CVE-2026-7273
description: Scanner reports a possible vulnerability match.
evidence: Target responded to a network request, but no affected product version or vulnerability condition was confirmed.
remediation: Verify the affected product, version, and vulnerability-specific condition.
risk_reason: The current evidence is insufficient to confirm the reported vulnerability.

title: CVE Vulnerability Detection
evidence: The detected product and version matched the scanner rule, and the vulnerability-specific detection condition was confirmed.
risk_reason: The vulnerability-specific detection condition was confirmed.

title: Possible Vulnerability Detection
evidence: Manual verification identified a different product that is not affected. The original match came from a generic response pattern.
risk_reason: Follow-up evidence contradicts the scanner result.

title: Web Technology Detection
description: Scanner identified the web framework used by the target.
evidence: The HTTP response contains framework-specific headers and page markers confirming the detected technology.
risk_reason: The result is informational technology identification.

title: Possible Web Technology Detection
description: Scanner suggests that a specific framework may be present.
evidence: The response contains a generic header that may be shared by multiple products, and no framework-specific marker was confirmed.

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy Header
description: The application is missing the Content-Security-Policy response header.
evidence: The captured HTTP response headers do not contain a Content-Security-Policy header.
risk_reason: A security header is confirmed missing.

title: Possible Missing Security Header
description: Scanner reports that a security header may be missing.
evidence: The scanner output does not include the actual response headers or identify which header was missing.
risk_reason: The scanner reports a configuration issue but the evidence is incomplete.

title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security Header
description: Scanner reports that HSTS is missing.
evidence: Manual verification shows the HTTPS response contains Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000.
risk_reason: Manual verification contradicts the scanner report.

title: Exposed Metrics Endpoint
description: A metrics endpoint appears to be publicly accessible.
evidence: Requesting /metrics returned HTTP 200 with process, runtime, and application metrics.
remediation: Restrict access to the metrics endpoint.
risk_reason: The metrics endpoint exposure is directly confirmed.

title: Possible Backup File Exposure
description: A possible backup file was discovered.
evidence: The URL returned HTTP 200, but the response body was not captured and the resource type was not verified.
remediation: Inspect the response content and verify the resource.
risk_reason: The resource exists but its sensitive nature is not confirmed.

title: Possible Admin Panel Exposure
description: Scanner reports an exposed administration page.
evidence: Manual inspection shows the URL is a generic 200-status custom error page and does not contain an administration interface.
risk_reason: The response is a generic error page rather than an admin panel.

title: Suspicious Application Response
description: The application returned an unusual response after a crafted request.
evidence: The response status and body changed, but the observed behavior cannot be reliably tied to a specific vulnerability, exposure, or misconfiguration.
risk_reason: The signal is suspicious but its security meaning is unclear.

title: SSH Service Version Detection
description: The scanner identified an SSH service and reported its banner.
evidence: Port 22 returned an SSH banner identifying the running SSH implementation and version.
risk_reason: The finding is service fingerprint information only.

title: Debug Endpoint Exposure
description: A debug endpoint may be accessible.
evidence: The endpoint returned HTTP 200 and exposed stack traces, environment details, and diagnostic information.
remediation: Disable or restrict the debug endpoint.

title: Cookie Missing Secure Attribute
description: A session cookie is missing the Secure attribute.
evidence: The captured Set-Cookie header for the session cookie does not include the Secure attribute.
remediation: Set the Secure attribute on session cookies.
risk_reason: The insecure cookie configuration is directly confirmed.

title: Prometheus Metrics Exposure
description: A Prometheus metrics endpoint appears to be accessible.
evidence: The /metrics endpoint returned HTTP 200 and the response content was confirmed to contain Prometheus metrics.
remediation: Restrict access to the metrics endpoint.
risk_reason: The metrics endpoint is confirmed accessible and may expose operational information.
